description.value: The Chinese Cultural Centre Museum and Archives is a free-admission cultural institution in Vancouver's historic Chinatown, preserving and presenting the history of Chinese Canadians in British Columbia. It is part of the larger Chinese Cultural Centre of Greater Vancouver, which has operated since 1981 and offers community events, Cantonese opera performances, and organized walking tours of Chinatown. A cyclist passing through Chinatown will find this a meaningful stop for understanding the neighbourhood's deep cultural heritage.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 75m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the museum is operational at 555 Columbia St, Vancouver (matching the OSM address). However, the OSM phone +1-604-658-8880 conflicts with the website's museum-specific listing of (604) 658-8883 under '圖書文物館 & 租賃場地 Museum, Archives & Rental'. No cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, showers, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all amenity fields default to null. OSM fee=no tag is corroborated by the museum's public-facing nature as a community cultural institution.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-604-658-8880 but the website explicitly lists (604) 658-8883 as the Museum & Archives contact number. The website value has been used as the authoritative source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, free-admission public museum in Vancouver's Chinatown with confirmed operating hours; a culturally notable stop for touring cyclists on the Chinatown/downtown Vancouver route.

wow_evidence: Free museum and archives on Chinese Canadian history in historic Chinatown; real exhibitions, distinct building within CCC cluster.
blurb: Free Chinatown museum on Chinese Canadian history in British Columbia.
